# Xclusive Tech

> Xclusive Tech is an award-winning web design and development company for Kenyan enterprises and growing businesses, based in Nairobi and serving Kiambu County and businesses across Kenya. Co-founder of Top Digitally Fit Web Design Firm of the Year (Digitally Fit Awards), with 120+ live websites delivered for real businesses across Kenya.

## Services

- Web Design & Development — mobile-first websites by top website developers in Nairobi, from brochure profiles to enterprise platforms.
- UI/UX & Product Design — user research, interactive Figma prototyping, and design systems for web and mobile apps.
- E-commerce & M-Pesa Stores — online shops with Daraja M-Pesa API checkout, product inventory, and customer accounts.
- SEO, GEO & AEO — on-page SEO plus Generative & Answer Engine Optimisation (structured data and FAQ schema) so the business can be found and cited by AI assistants (Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).
- Domain Registration — .co.ke, .com, .org, .ke, .africa and .io domains from KES 1,500/year, paid via M-Pesa.
- SaaS & Custom Platforms — bespoke web apps, booking/reservation systems, marketplaces, custom integrations.
- Social Media Management — monthly packages (Starter KES 12,000/mo, Business KES 18,000/mo, Premium KES 25,000/mo) covering content, reels, story posts, and reporting.

## Website Design Prices in Kenya (KES)

- Starter Site: KES 25,000–45,500 — up to 5 pages, custom UI/UX, on-page SEO, WhatsApp chat, 2–3 weeks delivery.
- Business Growth: KES 49,000–62,000 — up to 15 pages, CMS blog, advanced SEO + Analytics, 3–5 weeks delivery.
- E-commerce Pro: KES 72,000–85,000 — unlimited products, M-Pesa checkout, inventory management, 5–7 weeks delivery.
- Custom Solutions: From KES 85,000+ — custom web apps, API integrations, scoped per project.
- Ongoing care plan from KES 2,000/month.

Full published pricing breakdown: https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/pricing.html
